verdict.rationale: Windows documents broad hardware choice: users can pick from many device types and configurations, and most Windows 10 devices and accessories stay compatible with Windows 11. The 'without vendor lock-in' half is weak, because community reports show setup steers users into a Microsoft account. A local account is only reachable through workarounds such as going offline or entering a fake phone number, and the offline-to-online account path has a folder-naming bug. Missing for 10: documented support for installing on arbitrary or self-built hardware, a first-party lock-in-free setup path (local account), hands-on corroboration of a clean install on hardware of the user's choosing.
